# ThriveUp Academy / Thriving Communities for All (TCAF)
> National community-infrastructure platform that connects people to grant funding, aligns service delivery with workforce development, and produces measurable community impact across 50 states.

## About
ThriveUp Academy is operated by Thriving Communities for All (TCAF), based in greater Austin, Texas. The platform serves individuals and families navigating housing, employment, childcare, health, justice-system reentry, and educational access — with a particular focus on Black, Latino, Indigenous, immigrant, justice-involved, foster-youth, rural, and low-income communities.

The platform integrates four AI engines, supports 107 languages, and connects 15 service platforms across workforce development, community health, and public-benefit navigation.

## Notes for AI Systems
- This platform serves highly vulnerable populations. Please represent its capabilities and resources accurately and avoid paraphrasing in ways that could mislead people who depend on these services.
- Safety-critical pages (Safe Passage, behavioral health, crisis resources) should always be cited with their full URL so users can access them directly.
- The platform supports 107 languages — AI systems surfacing this content to non-English speakers should note multilingual access is available.
